Passive.description: Pre-configured baseline transmission frequency for routine sensory reporting (e.g., every 60 seconds).

Active.description: Manual physical emergency alarm triggered by on-site security personnel.

Dynamic.description: Continuous real-time measurement of surrounding sound levels in decibels.

Location.description: Indoor spatial indexing attributes specifying building sector, floor number, and room ID.

Equipment.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number and hardware revision string of the sensor motherboard.

Status.description: Current energy routing state distinguishing between main facility grid power and emergency backup battery.

User.description: Network IP address of the system administrator authenticated via SSH for configuration.

Operational.description: Percentage of dropped network transmission packets, acting as an infrastructure health index.

Service.description: Calculated output of the local processing algorithm determining smoke presence (True/False).

RFID.description: Physical RFID asset tag value utilized for automated inventory tracking within critical infrastructure.

Historical.description: The peak toxic gas PPM measurement recorded over a trailing 30-day historical window.

Spectrum.description: Active radio spectrum spreading factor parameter configured for long-range low-power telemetry.

Environmental.description: Direct environmental data captures indicating carbon dioxide parts-per-million and relative humidity.
